title: Unit-normalized integral compactification refinement comparison
statement: Fix the finite-field conventions [def-pur-conventions], $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and its completed coefficient system [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type map between separated finite-type schemes over $k$. Let $c=(j_c,p_c)$ and $d=(j_d,p_d)$ be supplied compactifications, and $z:c\to d$ a proper refinement with $j_cz=j_d$ and $zp_d=p_c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], define the open restriction $j_d^*Rz_*j_{c,!}M\to j_c^*j_{c,!}M$ by the pullback compositor followed by the proper counit. Define $\gamma_z:j_{d,!}M\simeq Rz_*j_{c,!}M$ as the unique isomorphism whose transpose under the open adjunction, followed by that restriction, is the open unit $M\to j_c^*j_{c,!}M$. Define the support refinement $Rp_{c,*}j_{c,!}M\simeq Rp_{d,*}j_{d,!}M$ as the inverse proper compositor, then $Rp_{d,*}(\gamma_z^{-1})$, including the equality transport $zp_d=p_c$. Proper composition is the adjoint conjugate of the normalized pullback compositor. No Cartesian condition is imposed on the original refinement square and no arbitrary comparison is selected.
